purpose: I manage a small catering company and need something in writing with a venue that keeps changing details after we already agree. At first it was dinner for 60 people, then they added late-night snacks, extra staff time, bar setup help, cleanup, and a longer event window. They also keep changing the headcount and asking for substitutions close to the date. I want something that clearly covers deposits, final guest count deadline, payment due dates, change fees, cancellation if they change too much too late, responsibility for leftovers and rentals, damage, and what happens if they ask for extra work the day of the event. I want it to feel professional and fair, not aggressive, and easy for both sides to review before signing.
title: Agreement
